title: DeriveBSD UI Collection Handoff Grant (v0.1)

lease_id.description: Lease/session identifier for this reviewed finite-collection handoff.

subject.description: Exact receiving subject holding this richer-lane grant and allowed to retrieve the reviewed finite collection.

offer_source_subject.description: Exact source subject that created or exposed the reviewed finite collection for handoff.

access_mode.description: First-cut reviewed finite-collection handoff is read-only only. Any write-enabled receive must return as later explicit work rather than widening this family.

retrieve_posture.description: First-cut richer finite-collection handoff is single-retrieve by default and auto-stops after the first successful retrieve.

collection_digest.description: Authoritative compact identity of the reviewed finite collection: sha256(utf8(JCS(authoritative_manifest))) from the joined ui.collection.handoff.manifest artifact.

expires_at.description: Optional absolute outer bound; effective_until must be no later than this value when present.

constraints.description: Closed-world typed vocabulary for first-cut retrieve posture. Future extra posture needs explicit ADR/spec work rather than hidden constraints.* drift.

effective_until.description: ISO8601 time. exact end of retrieve authority for this grant artifact.

description: Portable richer workstation transfer grant family for reviewed finite-collection handoff. This family is distinct from the frozen ordinary ui.datatransfer.* baseline and is the first richer B/C/D lane only.
